_summary: api.b2bendix.com = Bendix OCC (SAP Hybris Commerce Cloud) backend API. Open (HTTP 200) but returns product catalog data (parts, categories, CMS content slots) — NOT diagnostic trouble codes. Product search for 'SPN', 'DTC', 'fault code', 'diagnostic' returns 0 SPN/FMI hits. CMS pages return homepage/landing content slots. No DTC/SPN/FMI diagnostic data in API. VERI YOK.

records.text: OCC CMS pages API (142KB). Returns homepage uid/title/template/contentSlots (ProductCategoriesComponent, AnnouncementParagraph). Title: 'Bendix Customer Portal'. Description: 'b2bendix.com, your online home for business with Bendix. Submit orders on-line. Search by product, part number or name.' — e-commerce portal, not diagnostic database. 0 SPN/FMI refs.
OCC product search (2.69MB). Returns productCategorySearchPageWsDTO with facets (Type Number: 22XLT, AC CAB, AD-9, AD-IP, AD-IS). Product catalog — parts inventory, not DTC data. 0 SPN/FMI refs.
Product search for 'SPN' — 0 SPN/FMI hits in 1.4KB response. API is a parts catalog, not a diagnostic code database.
Product search for 'DTC' — 0 SPN/FMI hits (5 generic 'DTC' string matches in 1.4KB, likely product descriptions). No diagnostic code data.
Product search for 'fault code' — 0 SPN/FMI hits (4 generic matches in 1.6KB). No diagnostic code data.
Sample product detail (3KB): code=012103, name='Diagnostic Cable', marketType='Aftermarket (New)'. Product/part detail — not a DTC. No SPN/FMI.
